sourceFile: 07. BRS-161014 Report test change semi VP+CD of C2-E2 line 17.1.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has material grouping and pairing errors, so it cannot be used as final evidence.
issues: C2 test is compared to E2 normal instead of C2 normal.
Line is a required subgroup key but is not preserved.
Changed factor merges two reciprocal line swaps too broadly.
Measurement outcome is spurious aggregate-column parsing.
Evidence cites row 15 and omits row 22 for the C2 comparison.
correctionPlan: Rebuild comparisons by line: E2 test C2 semi versus E2 normal, and C2 test E2 semi versus C2 normal.
Add Line as a subgroup key or split into two changed-factor subresults.
Use row 22 as the C2 normal baseline and recalculate delta.
Remove the measurement outcome unless real measurement rows exist.
Cite title, purpose/content, header, all four result rows, and conclusion rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are not sufficient; row-level pairing evidence must include the correct same-line normal rows.
